title: THE SECTOR MAP, THIRD PASS
why: The critic scored the sector map card 3 of 5 again and named what was left: marker tags that floated away from their marks (the mark under a tag was treated as an obstacle, so a tag was pushed up a whole line), contract rows that were uneven (a bar on some rows, a word on the rule rows) and a panel that ended short of the map frame, a hot ground tag with a second explaining line that crossed the ring, zone names still loud against the marks, walls that competed with the tags, and the sector name and the muted words sector map on different baselines.
now: The sector map tags sit at their marks, every contract has a bar, the contracts list runs to the bottom of the map, and the hot ground says only its name.
